messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Data cleaning file issues
parts:
Hi Ada,

You are not describing your issue, you are only posting a description of what you try to do. 

Please make an effort to describe your issue and everything you have done to investigate it and to make it reproducible for people like me.

Thanks,

Vincent

------- Original Message -------
On Thursday, July 13th, 2023 at 11:43 PM, AN <adane...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi GGIR community!

I am currently analyzing GENEActiv .bin data and I'm having issues using the data cleaning file.

My .csv file is in this format:
"ID", "day_part5", "relyonguider_part4", "night_part4"
P001, 17, 17, 17

I am using this code:
GGIR(mode=c(1,2,3,4,5), f0=1, f1=0, do.report=c(2,3,4,5), windowsizes = c(5,900,3600), epochvalues2csv = TRUE, save_ms5rawlevels= TRUE,
datadir="~/Folder",
outputdir="~/Folder",
data_cleaning_file="~/Folder/data_cleaning_file.csv",
visualreport = TRUE, do.parallel = FALSE)

Any help is appreciated. Thank you :)
Ada
